_comment: The CloudsForge chart palette, as data. Transcribed from
docs/ecosystem/assets/chart-palette.md §8 without alteration — every value
there was produced by running the palette validator against the estate's
real dark panel surface #141110, and none of it was chosen by eye.
Grafana has no mechanism for registering a custom named palette, so this
file is not read at runtime: build-dashboards.py reads it and writes fixed
colours into every panel. That is the only way to get the validated set in
instead of Grafana's default, and it is why dashboards here are generated
rather than hand-edited. Changing a colour means changing this file and
re-running the build, which is also what stops the operator dashboards and
the product charts from drifting apart.
Rules that travel with the values, and are enforced in the generator:
- categorical slots are assigned IN ORDER and NEVER cycled. A ninth
series folds to Other, becomes small multiples, or the form is wrong.
- all-pairs forms (scatter, small multiples) cap at four, from ap_*.
- status colours are reserved and are never a series colour.
- status marks ship icon + label + colour, because the one surface a
colourblind operator reads under stress is the one that is red.
- quantiles are ORDINAL, so p50/p95/p99 take the sequential ramp rather
than three categorical hues.
